facts.fact: The National Police Service reports that on 22 January 2025 the Inspector General, at a presentation by the NPS Digitization Committee, highlighted the need to digitise the Occurrence Book; it is stated as a need, with no station said to hold a digital one.

As of 22 January 2025 the force's own NPS Digitization Committee, presenting at police headquarters, was tasked with driving the digitisation of police stations and services, the Occurrence Book among them.
